bull.b: Retiring the $50M convertible and raising capital materially reduced leverage and external refinancing risk. With cash, marketable securities and stated >12 months runway, the company has durable financial flexibility to execute product commercialization and absorb near-term investment without immediate debt pressure.

Having a live, auditable tokenized gold product with NAV tracking and operational issuance/custody is a structural milestone. It converts development risk into a commercial capability that can scale AUM, establish fee revenue, and validate the tokenization model across future commodities and products.

Strategic integrations with an AMM (Orca), market-maker (Wintermute) and large custodian (Equity Trust) address two structural adoption barriers: distribution and secondary liquidity. These partners can materially lower customer acquisition friction and enhance product utility over months to years.

bear.b: The firm has not yet converted product launch into sustained GAAP revenue, and operating/free cash flows remain negative historically. Absent durable revenue growth, the business will continue to rely on financing or asset monetization, making long‑term viability contingent on execution and AUM ramp.

A step-up in operating spend driven largely by equity compensation raises the fixed cost base and implies meaningful future dilution. If revenue growth lags, elevated operating leverage and recurring high noncash comp can erode shareholder economics and pressure margins as scale is pursued.

bear.t: Modest early AUM and onboarding friction
bear.b: Initial AUM is limited versus stated ambitions, and onboarding delays reduced early subscription momentum. That combination lengthens the timeline to meaningful fee revenue and increases execution risk: scaling distribution and resolving operational bottlenecks are prerequisites for sustainable economics.
